letter.company_line: Home Toolkit is a Melbourne residential structural and building engineering practice that investigates what is wrong with a house, why, and what to do about it.
letter.subject: Structural Engineer, Residential Building Inspections (SEEK 95883146)
paragraphs: Please accept my application for the graduate Structural Engineer role on your residential inspection team. Visiting homes, mapping damage, working out the likely cause and explaining it plainly to the owner is practical work I would enjoy learning with direct mentoring on every job.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019), where I studied structural principles, construction methods and hydraulics, and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia. That course included AS/NZS 1170 and AS 4100 coursework, hand calculations, technical reporting and drawings in AutoCAD and Revit.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge and field engineer on a community hall renovation and residential subdivision finishing works. I carried out site inspections and quality checks, reviewed structural and architectural drawings, wrote site and progress reports, and kept clients up to date on progress.

Forensic assessment, AS 2870 and AS 1684 would be new to me, and I would learn them from your team. I live in Melton, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own reliable transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa.
My resume is attached, and I would welcome the chance to talk about the role.

checklist: Search Gmail in:anywhere for Home Toolkit before applying (Gmail was not reachable on this tick)
Confirm the casual hourly role and the Eltham travel from Melton suit Marc
Open SEEK job 95883146 (expires 13 Dec 2026) and apply with the resume and cover letter from this folder

SEEK questions: work rights 485 full working rights to Dec 2027; licence yes; years as an engineering professional less than 1 (about ten months on site, 2019 to 2020); notice period, hourly rate and weekly hours for Marc to answer

screening_answers.a: Temporary graduate visa (Subclass 485) with full working rights until December 2027
Less than 1 year (field engineer and project-in-charge, Philippines, Apr 2019 to Feb 2020)
Marc to answer (advert range 45 to 55 dollars per hour)
